input.quote: 11.1 The Terminal Parties hereby grant to the Parties accessing APCN 2 at their respective terminal station, the right of use in the relevant Segment T (hereinafter referred to as "Terminal Station Right of Use") on the terms and conditions stated in this Paragraph 11, to the extent required for the use of its Allocated Capacity, for the purpose of using APCN 2 and carrying on the related activities at that location in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The operative licence grant is the Terminal Station Right of Use in Subparagraph 11.1, which runs to the Parties themselves (extended only to IRU purchasers in 11.5) and is not revocable at the grantor's discretion, running for the duration of the Agreement. Fallback element 2 is already satisfied: Subparagraph 22.3(a) lets a Party assign the whole of its rights and obligations to a successor at any time without Management Committee consent, and Paragraph 30 binds successors. Fallback element 1 fails, however: neither the grant nor any other clause extends the right of use to a Party's affiliates on written notice. The Affiliate provisions in 12.8 and 12.14 concern capacity use/transfer and are conditioned on Carrier status and a cash contribution, and assignment to an Affiliate under 22.3(c) requires transferring the whole of a Party's rights and obligations away rather than extending coverage. We therefore add one short subparagraph extending the Terminal Station Right of Use to a Party's Affiliates, Subsidiaries and Parent Company on written notice (the defined "Affiliate" captures only 10-50% holdings, so subsidiaries and parent must be named to reach affiliates in the playbook sense). We have not sought the preferred perpetual/irrevocable formulation, since the fallback is acceptable.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Extend the Terminal Station Right of Use to a Party's affiliates on written notice
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook requires the licence to reach our affiliates, so we have added a short subparagraph extending the Terminal Station Right of Use to a Party's Affiliates, Subsidiaries and Parent Company upon written notice to the Terminal Parties. Successor transfer is already covered by Subparagraph 22.3(a), so no further change is needed.

ops.text: Upon written notice to the Terminal Parties, the Terminal Station Right of Use granted to a Party under Subparagraph 11.1 shall extend to that Party's Affiliates, Subsidiaries and Parent Company, on the same terms and conditions.
